Definition: from G3516; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently:--be a child.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the Corinthians to be children in one thing only: in malice. In understanding they are to be grown men, but toward evil they are to stay as innocent as a little child who has never learned the trick.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe that is the right way round — childlike toward evil, never childish toward the truth.
